title: Can I SURVIVE 3 Check Chess?
summary: The creator plays online Three-Check chess against human opponents rated higher than him, aiming to win three games. You win by checking the opponent three times (or by checkmate). He discusses the typical 3-check trade-off of being up material but down a check, loses game 1 in a time scramble, and wins later games including one finished with a queen sacrifice for the third check.
rules: Standard chess rules and starting position.
Each check given counts; giving the third check wins immediately.
Clock with increment (seconds added per move).
win_condition: Give 3 checks (or checkmate). Creator's goal: win 3 games vs higher-rated opponents.
